| **Warranty** | 1-year limited warranty | 1-year limited warranty |
| **Specs / In the box** | over-ear, closed back, wireless, ANC with transparency, up to 40 hrs with ANC on, USB-C, Bluetooth 5.3 with two-device pairing, 254g, headphones + carry case + USB-C cable + 3.5mm cable | Same - over-ear, closed back, wireless, ANC with transparency, up to 40 hrs with ANC on, USB-C, Bluetooth 5.3 with two-device pairing, 254g, headphones + carry case + USB-C cable + 3.5mm cable |
